pairs.l: 1 — domestic life was more demanding before technology?
3 — families must be more disciplined in how they use technology?
4 — life is more interesting because of technology?
5 — they are not sure whether technology is good for us or not?
8 — that because of technology families communicate less?
9 — technology provides families with more opportunities to do things together?
11 — there are more advantages than disadvantages in technology?
12 — young people may become an easy target when using technology?

r1.exp: 1=B (Brian: 'grandmother took a WHOLE DAY to wash clothes'). 2=A (Alan: 'When I was a boy we LOOKED UP TO our elders. Today's kids JUST IGNORE them'). 3=E (Esther: 'Families need to learn to CONTROL OUR USE OF TECHNOLOGY'). 4=F (Fiona: 'YouTube is fantastic, computer games great fun'). 5=C (Catherine: 'I SOMETIMES WONDER'). 6=D (David: 'OBESITY is also a fast growing problem'). 7=B (Brian: 'Machines help with tasks that TOOK UP HOURS'). 8=C (Catherine: 'The family is physically together, but ARE THEY PAYING ATTENTION TO EACH OTHER?'). 9=D (David: 'Home entertainment is so much better that families are MORE LIKELY TO SPEND TIME TOGETHER'). 10=E (Esther: 'It's like we've got super-advanced new toys and WE DON'T YET KNOW HOW TO PLAY WITH THEM'). 11=D (David: 'on the whole I think technology is GOOD FOR US'). 12=F (Fiona: 'CYBERSPACE CAN BE A RISKY PLACE, you never know who you're talking to, and CYBER-BULLYING is horrible').

r13.exp: 'They would always quote Mrs Mallory: THAT BOY IS TONE DEAF' = roditelji nisu vjerovali da ima glazbeni talent = C.

r14.exp: 'The term was widely talked about by people who had NO IDEA OF ITS TRUE MEANING' = pogrešno shvaćeno od javnosti = B.

r15.exp: 'The summer after my finals I went to SPAIN... She told me I had a natural sense of rhythm' = dok je putovao u inozemstvu = B.

r16.exp: 'More than anything BECAUSE MY PARENTS WERE IRISH' = zbog porijekla/korijena = C.

r17.exp: 'BRENDAN... a man greatly respected in the POETRY world... said I should take up the bodhrán' = prijatelj pjesnik ga je potaknuo = C.

r18.exp: 'The efforts of the AMERICAN IRISH preserved the tradition' = zahvaljujući irskoj dijaspori = D.

r19.exp: 'Children learn spontaneously by watching and experimenting. (19)____. We sit them down and force-feed useless facts.' → F: When they get to school, we SUPPRESS THIS INSTINCT.

r20.exp: 'Train them to operate a spinning jenny. (20)____. We make them suffer this dehumanising system for nothing.' → E: Their skills are not only REDUNDANT but COUNTER-PRODUCTIVE.

r21.exp: 'Open up rich worlds... developing interests with help. (21)____. They use THEM to create projects.' → A: For example, the Essa academy in Bolton gives every pupil AN IPAD. 'Them' = iPads.

r22.exp: 'Plenty of teaching programmes to work with children. (22)____. Cutting across traditional subject boundaries, they manage a shipping warehouse.' → C: One of THEM, the Mantle of the Expert, encourages THEM to form teams of inquiry, solving an IMAGINARY TASK.

r23.exp: 'Woodmead, democratic method. (23)____. By such integration of content, learning is rooted in student's surroundings.' → B: Its programme got rid of TRADITIONAL SUBJECTS in favour of the students' EXPLORATIONS OF THEMES, such as gold, or relationships, or the ocean.

r24.exp: 'Programmes succeed DESPITE systems. (24)____. What they need is to CHANGE THE SYSTEM.' → H: Had they set out to ensure that children find learning DIFFICULT AND PAINFUL, they could not have done a better job.

r25.exp: 'The inspiration that LED to a successful business' — fiksna kolokacija: lead to = dovesti do.

r26.exp: 'He DID KNOW that his wife had a lot of bags' — past simple 'did know' za emfazu u prošlosti.

r27.exp: 'DESPITE having so many, she used just one' — 'despite' + gerund/noun (suprotni prijedlog).

r28.exp: 'Credentials WOULD be trusted' — kondicionalna prošlost: couldn't find anywhere where (something) would happen.

r29.exp: 'Until he set up the business (he) HAD BEEN WORKING in tech' — past perfect continuous za radnju koja je trajala u prošlosti do nekog trenutka.

r30.exp: 'Helping it to STAND OUT' — frazalni glagol: stand out = istaknuti se, razlikovati se od konkurencije.

r31.exp: 'Look like a designer RATHER THAN a used goods website' — fiksni izraz: rather than = umjesto, a ne.

r32.exp: 'Offers ACCESSIBLE prices' — 'accessible' = pristupačne, prihvatljive (cijene koje si mogu priuštiti).

r33.exp: 'Are DOING their souvenir shopping online' — 'do one's shopping' = obavljati kupovinu.

r34.exp: 'Prior TO travelling' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: prior to = prije.

r35.exp: 'Mainly DUE/THANKS/OWING to the increase' — fiksni izrazi: due to / thanks to / owing to = zahvaljujući, zbog.

r36.exp: 'WHILE/ALTHOUGH/WHEREAS many people prefer to pick up gifts during the trip, online shopping is a great idea...' — kontrast: while/although/whereas/whilst/albeit.

r37.exp: 'The right gift AT/FOR the right price' — 'at the right price' ili 'for the right price'; oba standardna izraza.

r38.exp: 'Allows you to MAKE the most of your time' — fiksna kolokacija: make the most of = maksimalno iskoristiti.

r39.exp: 'Your trip has COME to an end' — fiksna kolokacija: come to an end = završiti, privesti kraju.

r40.exp: 'You may HAVE lost or broken a souvenir' — 'may have' + past participle za mogućnost u prošlosti.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA samo završne ispite: manje stresa, više vremena za učenje, fokus na razumijevanje. ZA česte testove: praćenje napretka, motivacija, bolja priprema za završne. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
